newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal parliament deplores ETA killing in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Portugal parliament deplores ETA killing in Spain.

text.p: Portugal's parliament on Tuesday condemned the killing of a young Spanish politician by Basque separatists and sent a message of sympathy to his family.

"The assembly of the Republic, representing the Portuguese people, wishes to expresses its solidarity with the Spanish people...and the family of the innocent victim," said Antonio Almeida Santos, chairman of the legislature.

The murder of Miguel Angel Blanco, a 29-year-old Basque town councillor, by the ETA separatist group on Saturday prompted a furious reaction in Spain where millions of people took to the streets in an outburst of anger at the killing.
